Playing entails a lot of muscle memory. The biggest mistake I see is new players trying to play at speed or fast. Go slow, learn the movement, train your muscles and brain, and speed will come naturally. Turn your metronome down to 1/4 the speed it should be at, slower if you must, and play until the whole piece becomes simple and second nature. Even if you've memorized it, read the tab as you're playing.

Most importantly, have fun. Don't overplay, and don't play until your fingers are bloody. Stretch your fingers, get a nice grip exerciser, and use the lightest strings you can get away with for the purpose. Overplaying to the point of pain risks permanent nerve damage.
